title: AERR-Nav: Adaptive Exploration-Recovery-Reminiscing Strategy for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2603.17712v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Zero-Shot Object Navigation (ZSON) in unknown multi-floor environments presents a significant challenge. Recent methods, mostly based on semantic value greedy waypoint selection, spatial topology-enhanced memory, and Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as a decision-making framework, have led to improvements. However, these architectures struggle to balance exploration and exploitation for ZSON when encountering unseen environments, especially in multi-floor settings, such as robots getting stuck at narrow intersections, endlessly wandering, or failing to find stair entrances. translated_title: AERR-Nav：面向零样本目标导航的自适应探索-恢复-回忆策略
translated_abstract: 在未知多层环境中进行零样本目标导航（ZSON）是一项重大挑战。近期的相关方法大多基于语义价值贪婪路径点选择、空间拓扑增强记忆，以及将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为决策框架，已取得了一定进展。然而，这些架构在遭遇未见环境时，难以平衡零样本目标导航中的探索与利用，尤其是在多层环境场景下，例如机器人在狭窄路口卡住、无休止徘徊，或无法找到楼梯入口等问题。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了AERR-Nav，一个能够根据机器人所处环境动态调整自身状态的零样本目标导航框架。具体而言，AERR-Nav具有以下两个关键优势：（1）自适应探索-恢复-回忆策略，使机器人能够在三种状态之间动态转换，从而促进……
tldr: AERR-Nav提出了一种自适应探索-恢复-回忆策略，通过根据环境动态调整机器人状态，解决了未知多层环境中零样本目标导航的探索与利用平衡难题。
en_tdlr: AERR-Nav proposes an Adaptive Exploration-Recovery-Reminiscing Strategy that dynamically adjusts the robot's state according to its environment, addressing the exploration-exploitation balance challenge in zero-shot object navigation within unknown multi-floor environments.
